title: Acreage upkeep for a Deep Cove property

seo.title: Sample project: Deep Cove acreage upkeep | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: monthly upkeep of a Deep Cove acreage in North Saanich, with field mowing, hedge trimming and blackberry control on one plan.

summary: Monthly upkeep of lawns, long grass, hedges and beds on a two-acre lot.
scope: Blackberry control along the fence line
challenge: The owners travel for part of the year and wanted the two-acre property kept to the same standard while they were away.
approach: We set monthly visits, with extra mowing in spring when the grass grows fastest. Each visit covered the lawn near the house, the field edges and the hedges, and kept blackberry off the fence line.
After every visit the owners got photos and a short note, so they could see the property without being there.
result: A property kept to a set standard while the owners were away.
